title: Studio 首页的定制数量不计页签排列：只有排列定制的包显示为未定制
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named site, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7120821905). Source: L1 record 7120715954 on PR #36818 (#36626). That PR does not introduce it.

## What happens

The Studio landing page's per-package customization count is built in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/customizationMarks.ts`. `customizationCountsByType` and `customizationTotal` count the read's overrides and extensions only (read on `origin/main`, around l.89–100). The package customizations read now also lists tab `arrangements` (#36626). So a package whose only customization is a tab arrangement shows as uncustomized on the landing page.

reach: read from the code, not run in a browser. It reaches every admin who customizes only the tab order of a package's records.

## Expected

The landing page's count, per type and in total, includes the arrangements the customizations read lists, so the page reflects every customization.

## Acceptance

- A unit pin: a read with one arrangement and no overrides or extensions gives a non-zero total and a per-type count on the arranged type.
- Today's overrides and extensions counts are unchanged.

Dedupe: open issues for `customizationMarks` return only #36626 (in flight, the read that now lists arrangements).
